title: Open the fridge before moving items into it
description: Use this when the task requires putting an object into a fridge or other closed container.
content: Before moving an object into a fridge, first go to the fridge and open it. Once the fridge is open, use the move action to place the held object inside.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some egg and put it in fridge.

title: Complete the full sequence: take, cool, then place
description: Use this for tasks that combine object manipulation with temperature changes and final placement.
content: For tasks like cooling an item and putting it away, follow the ordered steps: go to the object's location, take the object, go to the cooling appliance, cool the object with the appliance, go to the target storage location, open it if needed, and then move the object into it.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some mug and put it in cabinet.

title: Pick up the target object before attempting to cool it
description: Use this when a task requires cooling or otherwise processing an object that is currently resting on a surface or inside a container.
content: When an object needs to be cooled, first navigate to its location and take it into inventory. Attempting to cool an object while it is still on a surface will fail; only after picking it up can you successfully apply a cooling action with an appliance.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some mug and put it in cabinet.

title: Transport items one at a time to the destination container
description: Use when moving multiple objects to a target container.
content: When collecting multiple items, pick up one item, carry it to the destination, and place it before returning for the next item. Attempting to pick up a second item while already holding one will fail.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two cd and put them in drawer.

title: Verify object presence before attempting repeated pickups
description: Use this when a take action fails repeatedly despite the object appearing in the observation.
content: If a take action returns "Nothing happens" multiple times, the object may not actually be reachable or the agent may already be holding an item. Check your inventory and re-examine the location to confirm what is actually available before retrying the same action.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two newspaper and put them in coffeetable.

title: Search systematically through storage locations to find the target object
description: Use when the target object is not immediately visible and must be located among multiple containers.
content: When searching for an object, methodically visit and open each plausible storage location such as cabinets, drawers, and appliances. Do not stop after finding unrelated items; continue until the target object is located.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some pan and put it in countertop.

title: Handle multiple identical items by temporarily placing one down
description: Use this when you need to pick up multiple items of the same type but can only carry one at a time.
content: If you are already carrying one item and need to pick up a second identical item, first move the carried item back to its original location or another surface to free your hands. Then pick up the second item and transport items one at a time to the destination.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two newspaper and put them in coffeetable.

title: Clean objects at a sinkbasin before storing them
description: Use this when the task requires cleaning an object before placing it elsewhere.
content: After picking up the target object, go to a sinkbasin and use the clean action with that sinkbasin. The cleaning action may require being at the correct sinkbasin location and holding the object.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some egg and put it in fridge.

title: Heat objects with the microwave by placing them inside first
description: Use this when a task requires heating an object and the microwave is the chosen heating appliance.
content: To heat an object in the microwave, first open the microwave, move the object into it, and then use the heat action. Attempting to heat the object while it is merely held or while the microwave is open without the object inside will fail.

title: Search other surfaces when the required object count is not met on the first surface
description: Use this when a task requires multiple instances of an object and only some are found at the initial location.
content: After picking up all visible instances of a target object from one surface, continue searching other furniture surfaces in the room to find the remaining required instances before placing them.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two keychain in drawer.

title: Retry failed pick-up actions after examining or moving
description: Use when a take action fails with "Nothing happens" even though the object is visible in the environment.
content: A failed pick-up attempt may be transient; re-examine the location or object, check inventory, and retry the take action. Sometimes moving away and returning to the location can reset the interaction and allow the pick-up to succeed.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Search multiple locations for target objects
description: Use when a task requires finding multiple instances of an object and the first location does not contain all needed items.
content: When collecting multiple objects, check various plausible surfaces and containers rather than expecting all instances in one place. If a location appears empty or lacks the target, move on to other nearby locations and inspect them.
